en.headline: School flu vaccine outreach switches to electronic consent forms from 17 August
en.dek: Parents can submit consent via the eHealth app by scanning a school-specific QR code, streamlining paperwork for the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach Programme.
body: The Centre for Health Protection announced that the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach Programme will introduce electronic consent forms starting 17 August.

Parents who have registered themselves and their children on the eHealth mobile application can scan a unique QR code issued by their child’s school to submit the consent form in a few steps. Personal details already held in eHealth will be pre-filled, reducing manual entry and the risk of handwriting errors.

Schools will begin receiving the dedicated QR codes from 12 August for distribution to parents. Each code is valid only for students enrolled at that school; parents with children at different schools must scan the corresponding code for each child. Paper forms will remain available for those who prefer them or cannot use the electronic route.

The centre said the change aims to simplify administration for schools and vaccination teams so that more students can receive their seasonal influenza vaccinations earlier in the school year. Both injectable and nasal-spray vaccines will continue to be offered under the programme.

zh.headline: 流感疫苗學校外展計劃下周一起推電子同意書
zh.dek: 家長可由8月17日起經醫健通掃描學校專屬二維碼為子女遞交接種同意書，簡化填表及行政程序。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日宣布，2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗學校外展計劃將推出全新電子同意書功能。
由8月17日起，家長可透過醫健通流動應用程式掃描其子女所就讀學校派發的專屬二維碼，為子女遞交接種季節性流感疫苗同意書。已登記醫健通的家長及子女，系統會自動預填個人資料，減少重複填寫及人手錯誤。
部門由8月12日起陸續向參與計劃的學校派發專屬二維碼，校方其後分發予家長。每間學校的二維碼只適用於就讀該校的學生；若子女就讀不同學校，須分別掃描各校二維碼。不便使用電子方式的家長可繼續使用紙本同意書。
中心表示，新措施可簡化家長填表流程及學校與醫護團隊的行政程序，讓學童更早接種季節性流感疫苗。計劃繼續提供注射式及噴鼻式疫苗。
